title: How do I install the RamosLabs design tokens in Vue, React, or plain HTML?
summary: Install @ramoslabs/tokens, import its CSS once at the entry, then use var(--token). Or link the served tokens.css.
short: Install `@ramoslabs/tokens` from npm{ref:npm-tokens}, import `@ramoslabs/tokens/css` once in your app entry{ref:ds-install}, and reference tokens such as `var(--color-primary)` in CSS{ref:mdn-var}. Without npm, link `https://design.ramoslabs.com/tokens.css` from plain HTML{ref:mdn-link}.

sections.heading: Install the package
body: `@ramoslabs/tokens` is public on npm under the MIT license; 0.1.0 is its only version{ref:npm-tokens}. The DS documents these four commands{ref:ds-install}.

sections.heading: Why the import path works
body: The package defines subpath exports: the root for typed values, `./css` for the CSS variables, and `./json` for the flat map{ref:ds-pkg}. Node resolves only the subpaths a package defines in `exports`{ref:node-exports}.

Test result, showing a bundler resolving them too: a Vite 8.3.5 project that imported `@ramoslabs/tokens/css` and `colorIndigo600` from the published 0.1.0 built successfully, and the output CSS contained `--color-primary:#4f46e5`{ref:measured-vite}. In development, Vite injects imported `.css` files into the page through a style tag{ref:vite-css}. To repeat the test, run the three commands printed in the measurement README{ref:measured-vite}: `bun install`, `bunx vite build`, then `grep -o 'color-primary:[^;]*' dist/assets/*.css`.

sections.heading: Vue 3 (Vite)
body: A Vue application is created with `createApp` and attached with `.mount()`{ref:vue-app}. Add the CSS import to that entry file once, not per component{ref:ds-install}.

code.label: src/main.ts
code.source:
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import '@ramoslabs/tokens/css'

createApp(App).mount('#app')

code.label: src/components/SaveButton.vue
code.source:
<template>
  <button class="cta" type="button">Save changes</button>
</template>

<style scoped>
.cta {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-surface);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-6);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.cta:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary-dark);
}

.cta:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
}
</style>

sections.heading: React
body: A React app renders into a root created with `createRoot`, usually once at startup{ref:react-root}. Put the same CSS import in that entry file{ref:ds-install}.

code.label: src/main.tsx
code.source:
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import '@ramoslabs/tokens/css'
import App from './App'

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<App />)

sections.heading: Typed values in TypeScript
body: The package root exports typed values such as `colorIndigo600`; the Vite test above imported it and built{ref:measured-vite}. For styling, keep using the CSS variables.

code.label: src/brand.ts
code.source:
import { colorIndigo600 } from '@ramoslabs/tokens'

export const brandAccent = colorIndigo600

sections.heading: Tailwind CSS
body: Tailwind documents square-bracket arbitrary properties as a way to write completely arbitrary CSS{ref:tw-custom}. Once the CSS import above is in place, the RamosLabs variables are regular CSS custom properties that any CSS can read{ref:ds-install}. This page did not measure a Tailwind build that emits them from arbitrary properties.

sections.heading: Components
body: The `SJ` components are not shipped yet; until they land, build from the tokens and the documented patterns{ref:ds-agents}.

faq.q: Do I need to import the token CSS in every component?
faq.a: No. Import it once at the app entry or root layout{ref:ds-install}.

faq.q: Can I use the tokens with Tailwind?
faq.a: The tokens are regular CSS variables once the CSS is imported{ref:ds-pkg}, and Tailwind documents arbitrary properties that take completely arbitrary CSS{ref:tw-custom}. This page did not measure a Tailwind build that reads them.

faq.q: Can I use the tokens without npm?
faq.a: Yes. Link `https://design.ramoslabs.com/tokens.css`{ref:mdn-link}; it answered 200 as `text/css` on 2026-10-27{ref:measured-served}.

faq.q: Does it work in a Vite project?
faq.a: A Vite 8.3.5 build importing `@ramoslabs/tokens/css` from the published package succeeded and emitted the variables{ref:measured-vite}.

faq.q: Are the SJ components available to install?
faq.a: Not yet. They are planned for `@ramoslabs/vue`{ref:ds-agents}.

faq.q: Can I hardcode a color or spacing value while I set up?
faq.a: No. The DS hard rule is to never hardcode a color, spacing, typography, radius, shadow, or motion value{ref:ds-agents}.

howto.name: Install and use RamosLabs design tokens

steps.name: Install the package
steps.text: Run `bun add @ramoslabs/tokens`, or the npm, pnpm or yarn equivalent{ref:ds-install}.

steps.name: Import the CSS once
steps.text: In the app entry, import `@ramoslabs/tokens/css` one time{ref:ds-install}.

steps.name: Use a token
steps.text: Reference variables such as `var(--color-primary)` and `var(--space-6)` instead of raw values{ref:mdn-var}.

steps.name: Optional: typed values
steps.text: For TypeScript logic, import typed values from the package root, for example `colorIndigo600`{ref:measured-vite}.
